title: mtf-facts lint output
description: The JSON document that lint --json writes. index, interface_diff, schema_coverage, scope and callers are optional; schema_coverage is written only when a schema handoff binds to the run, and callers only when the run has a change, --base or --diff.

scope.description: Which areas the run checked. areas_checked have their own manifest entries: those the change touches, or every area with --full-tree or without a change. areas_calling are the other areas that call a module listed in callers. areas_left_out are the rest. The three are disjoint and sorted.

callers.description: Each root or submodule area the change touches whose versions.tf or terraform block, or variables.tf or a variable block, changed, with every area that calls it by a local path.

base_floors.description: Null when the module is new.

line.description: The line of the call's source argument.

checked.description: The caller's area is in areas_checked.

candidates.description: The candidate_id of each structure.version-floor-understated candidate filed in the caller's area.

floors.description: The version floors a module declares, sorted by address.

source.description: The normalized provider source address; null for required_version, or for a source that is not a plain string.

constraint.description: The constraints as written, joined with ', ', a plain string unquoted; null for a provider entry with no version.

candidate.description: A detected defect for a model or an author to confirm. Never a finding on its own.

subject.description: Scoped to the area: '<area>:<address>', such as '.:var.name'. A path rule's subject is its file or directory path.

index_entry.description: The lines of one block or argument and its area-scoped subject. Entries nest; the innermost range that holds a line names that line's subject. Entries with the same lines, such as a one-line block and the argument in it, are in nesting order, outer first: the later entry names those lines.

finding.description: The seven required fields of the reviewer findings schema.
